The '''2022–23 Süper Lig''', officially called the '''Spor Toto Süper Lig 2022–23 season''', was the 65th season of the [[Süper Lig]], the highest tier [[Association football|football]] league of [[Turkey]]. The season has started on 5 August 2022 and ended on 7 June 2023.

[[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] clinched their 23rd league title, and first since the [[2018–19 Süper Lig|2018–19 season]], on 30 May 2023, with two games to spare.<ref name=":1">{{cite web|url=https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/galatasaray-clinch-23rd-turkish-league-title-2023-05-30/|title=Galatasaray clinch 23rd Turkish league title|date=31 May 2023|via=Reuters}}</ref>

Due to Turkey's poor UEFA ranking (20th at the end of the 2021–22 season), in this season only four teams qualified for the European cups instead of the usual five. The team in first place entered the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League]]'s second qualifying round, while teams in second and third place, as well the winners of the [[2022–23 Turkish Cup]], entered the [[2023–24 UEFA Europa Conference League]]'s second qualifying round.

==Teams==
A total of 19 teams contested the league, including 16 sides from the [[2021–22 Süper Lig|2021–22 season]] and [[2021–22 TFF First League]] champions [[MKE Ankaragücü|Ankaragücü]], runners-up [[Ümraniyespor]] and play-off winners [[İstanbulspor]]. Ankaragücü immediately returned to top level, while Ümraniyespor competed in the Süper Lig for the first time in their history.<ref>{{cite news|title=Ankaragücü tekrar Süper Lig'de|url=https://www.haberturk.com/son-dakika-haberi-ankaragucu-tekrar-super-lig-de-3426561-spor|publisher=[[Habertürk]]|access-date=2 May 2022|language=tr|archive-date=1 May 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220501162056/https://www.haberturk.com/son-dakika-haberi-ankaragucu-tekrar-super-lig-de-3426561-spor|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Profesyonel liglerde 2022-2023 sezonu başlangıç tarihleri belli oldu|url=https://tff.org/default.aspx?pageID=285&ftxtID=37580|publisher=[[Anadolu Agency]]|access-date=2 May 2022|language=tr|archive-date=29 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220429105858/https://www.tff.org/default.aspx?pageID=285&ftxtID=37580|url-status=live}}</ref> İstanbulspor returned to top level after 17 years.
Two teams were relegated to the [[TFF First League|2023–24 TFF First League]].
